entries.text: Dragon travels distances greater than 100 feet via natural Dimension Door.
entries.raw_text: 1,Dragon travels distances greater than 100 feet via natural Dimension Door.

entries.text: Dragon possesses lernaean regeneration abilities. If it loses a head, or limb, it will regrow two to replace it within 1-4 rounds if the stump is not burned with fire.
entries.raw_text: 1,Dragon possesses lernaean regeneration abilities. If it loses a head, or limb, it will regrow two to replace it within 1-4 rounds if the stump is not burned with fire.

entries.text: The dragon may climb surfaces as would a giant gecko.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon may climb surfaces as would a giant gecko.

entries.text: The dragon sprays a musk which will attract wandering monsters until removed by rubbing with pumpkin flesh. Every subsequent wandering monster check will result in an encounter.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon sprays a musk which will attract wandering monsters until removed by rubbing with pumpkin flesh. Every subsequent wandering monster check will result in an encounter.

entries.text: The dragon is an oracle and may foretell events if persuaded.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon is an oracle and may foretell events if persuaded.

entries.text: As a displacer beast, the dragon always appears to be 3 feet from it’s actual position. This adds two points to it’s saving throws, and subtracts 2 points from opponents attack rolls.
entries.raw_text: 1,As a displacer beast, the dragon always appears to be 3 feet from it’s actual position. This adds two points to it’s saving throws, and subtracts 2 points from opponents attack rolls.

entries.text: The dragon has the ability to mimic the form of anyone it has recently observed. Treat as a doppleganger.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon has the ability to mimic the form of anyone it has recently observed. Treat as a doppleganger.

entries.text: The dragon can see and strike ethereal and astral creatures, and those using magic to transport themselves to those planes.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon can see and strike ethereal and astral creatures, and those using magic to transport themselves to those planes.

entries.text: Undead must obey the dragon. It cannot create, or summon them, but any encountered must heed it’s commands.
entries.raw_text: 1,Undead must obey the dragon. It cannot create, or summon them, but any encountered must heed it’s commands.

entries.text: Dragon has claws of sharpness. On a natural twenty, the victim of the dragons claw attack will have a random limb severed.
entries.raw_text: 1,Dragon has claws of sharpness. On a natural twenty, the victim of the dragons claw attack will have a random limb severed.

entries.text: Dragon Speech. Those hearing the dragon speak must save or be charmed and become the dragons staunch supporters.
entries.raw_text: 1,Dragon Speech. Those hearing the dragon speak must save or be charmed and become the dragons staunch supporters.

entries.text: Frog tongue. The dragon can attack as would a Cave Fisher.
entries.raw_text: 1,Frog tongue. The dragon can attack as would a Cave Fisher.

entries.text: Gaze weapon causes diametric alignment shift. Treat as a Medusa’s gaze attack.
entries.raw_text: 1,Gaze weapon causes diametric alignment shift. Treat as a Medusa’s gaze attack.

entries.text: Dragon sprays caustic urine causing 2-12 points of damage and painful blistering.
entries.raw_text: 1,Dragon sprays caustic urine causing 2-12 points of damage and painful blistering.

entries.text: A slap of the dragon’s tongue will cause madness. Target must save or be stricken with a random mental illness.

entries.text: Dragon’s wings are edged with bony serrations. It may slash for 1-8 points of damage at targets twice as far away as normal melee range.

entries.text: Reptilian. Scaled or pebbled hide. The dragon is serpent-like, crocodilian or dinosaurian.
entries.raw_text: 1,Reptilian. Scaled or pebbled hide. The dragon is serpent-like, crocodilian or dinosaurian.

entries.text: Amphibian. Smooth and slimy skin. The dragon is salamander-like, or frogish.
entries.raw_text: 1,Amphibian. Smooth and slimy skin. The dragon is salamander-like, or frogish.

entries.text: Avian. Feathered and/or beaked and taloned. The dragon is somewhat bird-like.
